sentences.text: I hope you were able to see that.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: We were able to go there, but we weren’t able to go to the top.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: It was closed for maintenance or something.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: Well, I am sure I’ll be able to go back someday!

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.text: I ate at the new taco truck.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: I was going to go there, but I got busy.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.text: Good, but it is a bit pricey.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.text: Yeah, I was going to have two tacos, but at seven bucks apiece, I just had one.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: Hey, check out my new car!

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.text: Oh, this is the one that was for sale.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: Yeah, the guy sold it to us cheap.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.text: Is there something wrong with it?

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: I wasn’t going to buy it at first, but after driving it, I love it.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.text: Well, as long as it runs.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.text: So, can I get a ride home?

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: I was just going to offer you one.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.text: I was just going to call you.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.text: I was going to ask if you are still coming to the party.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: I am really looking forward to it.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.text: I am so glad you can make it.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: Are you still planning on having it outside?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.text: We were going to, but it looks like it is going to rain.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.text: I thought you were going to play futsal.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: I was, but we had to cancel.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: Bob was going to drive us, but he got called in to work.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.text: Oh, he was your only ride?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.text: Well, now you get to hang out with me!

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: I was just going to say that!

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: Have you ever been to Europe?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.text: I haven’t technically been there, but I had a layover in Paris.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: That doesn’t really count, does it?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.text: No, but I'm hopefully going next year.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: Where are you planning on going?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.text: I’m tentatively planning on going to Spain.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: Oh, Spain is definitely worth the visit.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: What are you doing this weekend?

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: I’m most likely going to stay home too.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.text: Do you want to do something?

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: No, I'm really looking forward to just relaxing at home.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: Have you tried the new Italian restaurant?

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: Yes, you should definitely check it out.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: Well, I especially recommend the ravioli.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.text: Thanks, I'll surely give it a look.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: So, did you get the results of your test score?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.text: No, but I've been anxiously awaiting the results.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.text: This test was definitely harder than the last one.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.text: I hear all the students eventually pass the class anyway.
